purpose: React component that renders failed welcome records from IDB, displays human-readable recovery instructions per failure reason, and supports per-record dismiss. Mounted as a 'Pending Invitations' tab inside SettingsModal.

public_api.name: PendingInvitations
public_api.description: React component. Loads FailedWelcomeRecord[] via loadFailedWelcomes(), renders each with inviter pubkey (short), group name if available, failure reason label, and recovery instruction. Dismiss calls forgetFailedWelcome and (for decrypt_failed) inviteReader.markAsRead. Refreshes on notestr:failed-welcomes-changed DOM event.

external_ports.name: loadFailedWelcomes
external_ports.description: Reads FailedWelcomeRecord[] from IDB. Consumed on mount and on notestr:failed-welcomes-changed.

external_ports.name: forgetFailedWelcome
external_ports.description: Removes one record from IDB by giftWrapEventId. Called on dismiss.

external_ports.name: inviteReader.markAsRead
external_ports.description: Marks the gift-wrap event as read via client.invites. Called ONLY for failureReason === 'decrypt_failed' on dismiss.

test_targets: recoveryInstruction() — maps failureReason string to human-readable instruction
failureReasonLabel() — maps failureReason string to display label
inviterShort() — returns first 8 chars of hex pubkey
Dismiss path for decrypt_failed (calls markAsRead + forgetFailedWelcome)
Dismiss path for join-failure (calls forgetFailedWelcome only, NOT markAsRead)
